added_tests_after_review: Pull-request dispatch: the base is the merge base, only affected projects are queued, a skipped project is recorded, and a missing base branch falls back to no_base. Merge queue: every affected project at its current scope is required; another project's run or an older scope does not satisfy it; one failed project blocks; a skipped project never blocks.

known_tradeoffs: Changes to the root Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, rust-toolchain or .cargo/config affect every Cargo-scoped project. This is conservative.

Only Cargo path dependencies (including [patch] path entries and workspace = true) and Nix path flake inputs are graph edges. Registry dependencies and Nix expressions that read sibling directories need depends_on.
When no project on a repository is scoped, automation and review behave exactly as before.
The web service produces no kiln_core::gating GateResults; scope identity is bound into the run, candidate and attempt identity and the review CI check.
